target_audience: All Students (UG, PG, Hostelers & Day Scholars)

faqs.question: What is the minimum attendance percentage required to write semester exams, and what happens if I am in the 80% to 89% range?
student_query_variations: can i write exam with 85% attendance
what is condonation fee attendance sathyabama
faqs.official_answer: Sathyabama requires a minimum of 90% attendance in each course to be automatically eligible for End Semester Examinations. If your attendance falls between 80% and 89% due to genuine medical illness or official university on-duty (OD), you may be granted condonation upon Dean approval and payment of the condonation fee. Attendance below 80% strictly disqualifies you from writing the exam and requires repeating the course.
faqs.verified_by: Official Sathyabama Academic Regulations & Student Handbook 2026-2027

faqs.question: What are the college bus arrival and departure timings for regular days and special training?
student_query_variations: what time do college buses leave sathyabama
faqs.official_answer: The university fleet of 150+ buses arrives before 8:45 AM every morning. On regular instructional days, buses depart campus at 3:30 PM. For students attending placement training, Civil Services Academy, or library study, special evening buses depart at 5:00 PM.

faqs.question: What is the weightage split between Continuous Assessment (CAE) and End Semester Exams, and how many marks are needed to pass?
student_query_variations: how many marks to pass end sem
faqs.official_answer: Theory courses are split 50% for Continuous Assessment Exams (CAE 1 and CAE 2) and 50% for the University End Semester Examination. To pass, you must score at least 50% in the End Semester Examination itself, AND achieve at least 50% total aggregate when combining CAE and End Semester marks.

faqs.question: How long do I have to apply for paper revaluation after results are released, and what is the official results link?
student_query_variations: how to apply for answer sheet photocopy
faqs.official_answer: Students can apply for answer script photocopies and revaluation within 10 days of result publication via the Controller of Examinations. The official examination results portal is https://result.sathyabama.ac.in/.

faqs.question: What is the curfew time for hostel students to return to campus in the evening?
student_query_variations: what time to return to hostel
faqs.official_answer: All hostel students must return to their respective hostel blocks before 6:30 PM. Movements in and out of campus are recorded using biometric security scanners.
faqs.verified_by: Hostel Administration & Dean of Student Affairs

faqs.topic: Dream and Super Dream Placement Upgrade Policy
faqs.question: If I already have a job offer, can I sit for higher CTC Dream or Super Dream companies?
student_query_variations: can i attend placements after getting placed
minimum package hike to sit for next company
faqs.official_answer: Yes, under the CDC Upgrade Policy: A student holding an offer up to 5 LPA can attend a Dream Company drive (5 to 10 LPA) only if the new package offers at least a 1.5 LPA hike over the existing CTC. To sit for a Super Dream Company (>10 LPA), the new package must offer at least a 3.0 LPA hike over the current CTC. In all cases, 90% attendance in placement training is mandatory.
faqs.verified_by: Centre for Career Guidance and Development (CDC)
